name: Accessible Command Palette
description: Keyboard-driven quick command launcher with live fuzzy filtering, arrow-key navigation, Enter selection, and TypeScript/JavaScript source.

preview.caption: Interactive live preview — type to filter commands, use Up/Down arrows and Enter.

install: Copy palette.html, palette.css, and palette.ts (or compiled palette.js) into your web app.
usage: Mount the palette panel inside a <dialog> or overlay container and supply your application commands array.

verification.label: Source Reviewed & Live Sandboxed
verification.details: Implements listbox ARIA semantics, keyboard arrow navigation, and live selection announcement.
